situation (example wording): "Where does Houston stand on murder rate in 2024?", "where does Houston stand on murders in 2024 in the state"
what the app does today: Declined: "I didn't understand \"where does\" or \"stand on\"."
proposed behavior: "Stand on", "stands in" and "stand for" are read as "rank": where a city stands is where it ranks (the rankings decision of 2026-11-10). With the state or the nation named, the answer is its place out of how many, with the two cities above and the two below; with no scope named, it asks whether to rank among the state's cities or among U.S. cities of its size. One Part I crime, one year, a count or a rate per 100,000, as for "rank".
exact default or choices offered: As for "rank": the state's cities or U.S. cities of its size.
why: Jeff 2026-11-17 (through the coordinator): approved as its own small change after P131.
test cases: scripts/test-nibrs-historical.ts (the block "Where does X rank", the stand-on cases).
